area: Filter and Display and View Options
title: Events toggle shows and hides event blocks on the grid
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. At least one event and one shift exist on the visible range.
3. You are on the Schedule page with Events ON (default).
expected: 1. Off: event blocks disappear from the grid; shifts remain.
